children: US heating oil prices extended losses below $4.60 per gallon as traders weighed the prospect of increased fuel supplies following President Donald Trump’s claim of an immediate energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine.

The announcement followed his statement last week that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to global markets to help lower fuel prices, alongside his administration’s temporary easing of US sanctions on Russian fuel, potentially allowing more supplies to reach global markets.
Meanwhile, International Energy Agency Executive Director Fatih Birol urged governments to accelerate planned diesel releases and consider boosting supplies.
These developments overshadowed escalating Middle East tensions, including renewed strikes on Saudi Arabia’s civilian infrastructure and tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz.
Elsewhere, Gulf of Mexico oil producers were working to restore output at offshore platforms after Hurricane Isaias made landfall.

title: Heating Oil Extends Losses
